name: Ledger lines (minimal)
summary: One aligned, permanent line per step printed as the step finishes, led by a word badge (ok / warn / FAIL), with one transient console.status spinner for the step in flight. No Live, no Progress, no title; TTY and non-TTY output are the same lines.
mockup:
SUCCESS (TTY, final frame)
  ok    identify project root        C:\src\acme (pyproject.toml)
  ok    identify Git top-level       C:\src\acme
  ok    configure pre-commit hooks   prek.toml updated, 2 hooks added
  ok    prek install                 Git shims already installed
  ok    prek update --check          hook revisions up to date
  ok    detect-secrets scan          .secrets.baseline created
pkgdx init: done in 2.9s

(while running, a single transient line sits under the ledger:)
⠹ prek update --check ...

WARN (TTY, final frame)
  ok    identify project root        C:\src\acme (pyproject.toml)
  warn  identify Git top-level       not a Git repository, using project root
        -> Run `git init` to enable pre-commit hooks
  ok    configure pre-commit hooks   prek.toml unchanged
  ok    prek install                 Git shims installed at project root
  warn  prek update --check          pkgdx v0.4.2 -> v0.5.0 available
        -> Update remote hook revisions - `prek update`
  ok    detect-secrets scan          .secrets.baseline exists, reused
pkgdx init: done in 2.9s with 2 warnings

FAIL (TTY, final frame)
  ok    identify project root        C:\src\acme (pyproject.toml)
  ok    identify Git top-level       C:\src\acme
  FAIL  configure pre-commit hooks   prek.toml could not be parsed
        Invalid value (at line 12, column 9)
        -> Fix prek.toml, or regenerate it with `pkgdx init --reset`
pkgdx init: failed at step 3/6 (3 steps not run)
step_states: pending: not shown | running: transient console.status line, 'dots' spinner + label + '...' | ok: 'ok' green | warn: 'warn' bold yellow + indented '->' hint line | fail: 'FAIL' bold red reverse-free, uppercase so it differs from ok/warn without colour, + message line + '->' hint
header: None. The command name appears once, in the closing summary line.
success_summary: 'pkgdx init: done in <elapsed>' (plus ' with N warnings' when relevant), one line.
warning_presentation: Inline under the step that warned: the warn badge, the detail in the detail column, and an indented '->' next-action line. Nothing is logged above the ledger; the warning logging moves out of _core into the CLI layer.
failure_presentation: Inline at the failing step: FAIL badge, cause in the detail column, raw parser message indented beneath, '->' next action, then the summary line naming the step number and how many steps did not run. No traceback for expected errors; with -d the logger's traceback prints after the ledger. Ctrl-C: the status line is replaced by '  stop  prek update --check   interrupted' and 'pkgdx init: interrupted, no cleanup performed', exit 130.
state_change_reporting: The detail column of every step always shows Result.detail (created / updated / unchanged / reused), so state changes are visible by default without -d.
non_tty_behaviour: Identical lines without ANSI and without the status spinner (Rich drops styling on a non-terminal console). Each line is printed when its step finishes, so a CI log streams. Example: '  ok    prek update --check          hook revisions up to date' ... 'pkgdx init: done in 2.9s'.
rich_primitives: Table.grid (one-row grid per step with fixed column widths)
risks: Column widths must be fixed up front (longest label), or rows printed one at a time won't line up.
No view of the remaining steps, so the user can't see how far through the run is (no 'step 3 of 6' while running unless the status text says so).
The braille spinner from console.status needs a font that has braille (Cascadia does; legacy conhost fonts may not). Spinner 'line' (-\|/) is the safe fallback.
Moving warning logging out of _core into the CLI layer is a real refactor, not just a styling change.
curation_note: Merged with status-badges (systemd): keep the word-badge ledger; badges are fixed-width words (ok / warn / FAIL / skip), not brackets. After a FAIL, do not print skip rows - the summary line states how many steps did not run.
